prompt: Add a docstring to every public function in notes/search.py that doesn't already have one.
verify: python3 -c "import notes.search as s; assert all(getattr(s,f).__doc__ for f in ['by_text','by_tag','sort_notes','all_tags'])"

prompt: Add a method called `is_empty` to the Note class in notes/models.py that returns True when the body is blank or only whitespace.
verify: python3 -c "from notes.models import Note; assert Note(id=1,title='x',body='  ').is_empty(); assert not Note(id=1,title='x',body='a').is_empty()"

prompt: In notes/storage.py, add a method `titles()` to NoteStore that returns a list of all note titles.
verify: python3 -c "from notes.storage import NoteStore; import tempfile,os; p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'n.json'); s=NoteStore(p); s.add('A'); s.add('B'); assert s.titles()==['A','B']"

prompt: Add a function `count_by_tag(notes)` to notes/search.py that returns a dict mapping each lowercase tag to how many notes carry it.
verify: python3 -c "from notes.search import count_by_tag; from notes.models import Note; n=[Note(id=1,title='a',tags=['x']),Note(id=2,title='b',tags=['X','y'])]; assert count_by_tag(n)=={'x':2,'y':1}"

prompt: The README is missing a section about running the tests with coverage. Add one under the Tests heading.
verify: python3 -c "assert 'coverage' in open('README.md').read().lower()"

prompt: Add a `--limit` option to the `list` command in notes/cli.py that shows at most N notes.
verify: python3 -c "from notes.cli import build_parser; a=build_parser().parse_args(['list','--limit','5']); assert a.limit==5"

prompt: Add a function `longest_note(notes)` to notes/search.py returning the note with the longest body, or None for an empty list.
verify: python3 -c "from notes.search import longest_note; from notes.models import Note; assert longest_note([])is None; assert longest_note([Note(id=1,title='a',body='x'),Note(id=2,title='b',body='xxx')]).id==2"

prompt: parse_date in notes/formatting.py crashes on empty or malformed input. Make it return an empty string instead of raising, and add a test for it in tests/test_formatting.py.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.formatting import parse_date; assert parse_date('')==''; assert parse_date(None)==''"

prompt: Add an `update` method to NoteStore in notes/storage.py that takes a note id plus optional title, body and tags, updates only the fields given, saves, and returns the updated note or None if not found.
verify: python3 -c "from notes.storage import NoteStore; import tempfile,os; p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'n.json'); s=NoteStore(p); s.add('A','b'); n=s.update(1,title='Z'); assert n.title=='Z' and n.body=='b'; assert s.update(99) is None"

prompt: Add tag filtering to the search command in notes/cli.py via a --tag option, so results are filtered by both query and tag. Add a test for the parser in tests/.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.cli import build_parser; a=build_parser().parse_args(['search','x','--tag','work']); assert a.tag=='work'"

prompt: sort_notes in notes/search.py silently falls back to created for unknown keys. Make it raise ValueError with a helpful message instead, and add a test.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.search import sort_notes; import pytest; pytest.raises(ValueError, sort_notes, [], 'bogus')"

prompt: Add a `stats` command to the CLI that prints the total note count and the number of distinct tags. Add a test.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.cli import build_parser; build_parser().parse_args(['stats'])"

prompt: NoteStore.load crashes if the JSON file is corrupt. Make it raise a clear ValueError naming the file path, and add a test.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.storage import NoteStore; import tempfile,os,pytest; p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'bad.json'); open(p,'w').write('{{{'); pytest.raises(ValueError, NoteStore(p).load)"

prompt: Add an `archived` boolean field to the Note dataclass, defaulting to False, making sure to_dict and from_dict handle it and old files without the field still load.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.models import Note; assert Note(id=1,title='x').archived is False; assert Note.from_dict({'id':1,'title':'x'}).archived is False"

prompt: Add pagination to listing: a `paginate(notes, page, per_page)` function in notes/search.py, --page and --per-page options on the list command, and tests. Pages are 1-indexed.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.search import paginate; from notes.models import Note; n=[Note(id=i,title=str(i)) for i in range(1,11)]; assert [x.id for x in paginate(n,2,3)]==[4,5,6]"

prompt: Add archive support end to end: an `archive` CLI command, a store method to set the archived flag, exclude archived notes from list by default with a --all flag to include them, plus tests.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.cli import build_parser; build_parser().parse_args(['archive','1']); a=build_parser().parse_args(['list','--all']); assert a.all"

prompt: Rename the `all()` method on NoteStore to `list_notes()` everywhere it is used across the whole project, keeping all tests passing.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.storage import NoteStore; assert hasattr(NoteStore,'list_notes')" && ! grep -rn '\.all()' notes/

prompt: Add CSV export: an `export_csv(notes)` function in notes/formatting.py returning CSV text with a header row, an `export` CLI command, and tests.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.formatting import export_csv; from notes.models import Note; out=export_csv([Note(id=1,title='a,b')]); assert 'id' in out.splitlines()[0]; assert '\"a,b\"' in out"

prompt: The search is case-insensitive for text but by_tag compares lowercased every call, which is slow. Add a cached `tags_lower` property on Note and use it in by_tag and all_tags, keeping behaviour identical.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.models import Note; assert Note(id=1,title='x',tags=['A']).tags_lower==['a']"

prompt: Add a `merge(other_store)` method to NoteStore that copies notes from another store, reassigning ids to avoid clashes and skipping exact duplicates by title and body. Add tests.
verify: python3 -m pytest -q && python3 -c "from notes.storage import NoteStore; import tempfile,os; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); a=NoteStore(os.path.join(d,'a.json')); b=NoteStore(os.path.join(d,'b.json')); a.add('X'); b.add('Y'); a.merge(b); assert a.count()==2"
